answer: To prevent an attacker from flooding an autonomous AI network with fake agents, a decentralized economy can implement a staked resource vault where each identity must lock collateral before participating. This economic barrier acts as a financial jetty, absorbing the cost of mass node deployment. If an agent behaves maliciously, its staked assets—tinted an immutable umber on the ledger to signify penalty states—are permanently slashed, making unchecked Sybil generation economically non-viable.
